build: L3, part 1: the messages and small fixes (#91). A planting dragged to another day says how far, from what day to what day ("4 days later, Apr 14 → Apr 18"); how a drag moves is not changed. A drop turned down because the ground is held names the day it was judged on: the map's date for a crop from the library, its own date for a planting. While a crop is carried, Done at the foot of the library puts it down. An end of a planting dragged along its bed on the map says what it did, from the feet it held to the feet it holds, with Undo, and the tip under the pointer no longer prints "null". "Pinned" reads "Its own days. Empty the box to follow your list." A click on a bare row of the Timeline says the date moved, with Undo, which puts it back. His own days typed for a crop name the varieties that keep days of their own there, and offer "Set its 2 varieties too" (one more step, with its own Undo, that says what moves first) and "See the plantings". A planting's panel puts its schedule and what it is expected to give before its boxes. "Seeding in trays" fits its "Days counted from" box (taken off tests/known-faults.json). The map's key wraps to a second line before a group waits behind "+n"; it stands over the map, which holds still. "Grown on without heat" reads "On the unheated benches"; a celled tray with no cells set says where they are set. With nothing counted, one quiet link on the Assumptions page leads to what can wait. Words and answers only: nothing stored, no figure moves by itself.

changes.did: Messages say what happened, each with Undo: how many days a drag moved, the date a refused drop was judged on, a resize's feet before and after, a click on a bare Timeline row; and Done puts a carried crop down.
steps: On the Timeline at Days, drag a planting four days later: the message reads "4 days later" with the two dates, and Undo puts it back.
Click a crop in the library: Done appears at the foot of the library; press it and the crop is put down.
On Assumptions, type days for a crop whose varieties carry their own: the message offers "Set its 2 varieties too" and "See the plantings".
